_comment: Speech-recognition vocabulary (Sarvam `keyterms`). OFF by default (STT_KEYTERMS=false) and only accepted by Sarvam for saaras:v4.

Why off: in server/voice_eval (validate.py keyterms, 92 trials per config) keyterms caused 7 wrong medical substitutions (4 with the hospital name added) versus 0 without: amiodarone -> amlodipine, glipizide -> glimepiride, clonidine -> clopidogrel, valsartan -> 'AVP Hospital'. A wrong real drug name in a patient record is worse than a misspelling, and no list covers every drug.

If enabled, prefer site-specific names patients actually say (doctor names, local brands) in a file named by STT_VOCABULARY_EXTRA_FILE, and re-run server/voice_eval/stt_ab.py with look-alike drugs before trusting it. Up to STT_KEYTERM_LIMIT (max 50) terms are sent, categories in the order listed.
Never put patient data in this file.
